Translates a chart into plain-language, citable findings. Sits in the right column of a chart section.

```jsx
<KeyInsights title="What the data tells us about the CRM market right now" items={[
  { lead: 'Salesforce is consolidating enterprise dominance.', text: 'Install share grew from 35.1% to 38.2% YoY.', attribution: '→ See primary chart' }
]} />
```

Bold the lead clause, keep the rest as supporting detail, and always point at the exhibit that backs the claim.
